correctness.rationale: The frozen proof exactly factors the difference, showing strictly positive iterates and preserved sign. Uniform small-cone expansion yields z_n=Theta(1/n); monotonicity of log ratio forces ratio→1 for tau<1, ratio fixed at tau=1, and dominant-species selection for tau>1. In synchronizing phase, summable normalized imbalance squares bootstrap z_n=1/(An)+summable remainder (A=c(1+tau)/2) and compensated logarithmic product yields finite nonzero D. In selecting phase y/x=O(n^-delta) gives summable errors and finite positive minority amplitude L. At tau=1 reciprocal increment c-v z+O(z^2), with v=eta(1-eta)(a-b)^2, yields the finite H correction -v/c log n; a=b gives v=0 and exact linear reciprocal. The n limits are pointwise fixed-parameter, not uniform as tau→1. Inspected symbolic verifier identities; numerics at finite horizons only diagnostic.
